description: This file contains serializer and copier implementations for the Collection<T> class in the Orleans.Serialization framework. It provides methods for serializing, deserializing, and deep copying collections, along with the necessary external references and generated code helpers.

classes.name: CollectionCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Collection<T>, handling encoding and decoding of collection instances including reference management.

classes.name: CollectionCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier implementation for Collection<T> providing deep copy functionality during serialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes the collection to a writer stream with handling for reference and size.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a collection from a reader stream, reconstructing the collection with correct type and references.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the collection's elements into the writer stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into the provided collection object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the collection.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies elements from one collection to another.
